content.text: Jimmie, Carl, and Sam defend the ruined temple, retrieve supplies from the _Ann_, and escape through tunnels to the forest. They attempt to signal the _Louise_ and _Bertha_ before returning to the aeroplane. Havens, Ben, and Glenn travel through the Andes; after repairs and miners’ threats, the three machines reach a camp near Lake Titicaca. Jimmie and Ben fly the _Louise_ to the mysterious fortress, while Havens and Sam take the _Ann_ there separately. Inside, they confront and capture Redfern, then return to camp and Quito. The “Mystery of the Andes” proves to be an electrically lit fortress. The appended narratives describe Johannesburg, convent abuse, Sarah Richardson’s escapes from the Grey Nunnery, and historical Catholic Inquisition atrocities.
